I visited the VA's Mobile Medical Unit today to hear from patients & providers about their experiences.

#WA03 veterans have made it clear they're struggling to get care. It's unconscionable.

It's a first step, but two of my amendments passed to help track & improve rural care. https://t.co/3T3NvTvFdl

I visited Vancouver Clinic to learn about their work with #WA03 Medicare Advantage patients.

We got to discuss their unique model of care and their recent expansions to meet local needs.

I'll keep working to make sure all folks can access high-quality, affordable care. https://t.co/j04Rjlu6Gx

🚨 Medicare's open enrollment period begins today!

Whether or not your plan is changing, you can make sure your healthcare and prescription drug coverage best fits your needs.

Until December 7, you can compare and adjust 2024 coverage options at https://t.co/FHifwUPQWD.

The open enrollment period for Health Insurance Marketplace coverage begins today!

You can apply for and adjust healthcare coverage until January 15.

Just visit https://t.co/4r5A10nFKi.

Read more:
https://t.co/rFVaAWXYHH

The sewer main in the north end of Long Beach is 65+ years old.

Its failure could lead to groundwater contamination, so I brought funds home to help replace it.

It'll save ratepayers money, boost capacity for growth, and ensure wastewater gets to the treatment facility safely. https://t.co/moE9Azugkn

It can be easy to take clean water for granted, but its reliability and quality is critical to the health and safety of our communities.

I secured funds for the Washougal Wastewater Treatment Plant to double its capacity, accommodate growth, and reduce the burden on ratepayers. https://t.co/mP0zeEfJOq

The Salmon Creek Treatment Plant treats millions of gallons of wastewater each day for 120,000+ folks across Clark Co.

I secured funds to replace aging equipment, which will cut energy consumption, reduce impacts of truck hauling, & return more water to our natural environment. https://t.co/apLj587Ofj

I recently secured $3M for equipment upgrades at the Salmon Creek Treatment Plant which serves 150,000 Clark County residents.

I'm glad Discovery Clean Water Alliance could stop by to discuss the investment & my work to ensure ratepayers don't foot the bill for PFAS mitigation. https://t.co/aFSpg05pcC

For folks with disabilities who rely on long-term care through Medicaid Buy-In, an age cap at 65 can present them with the difficult choice of limiting their income to receive care through Medicaid or losing coverage by continuing to work. ⬇️

When families know how to prepare hearty meals and find nutritious options at the store, they have brighter futures.

I'm leading a bipartisan effort to support nutrition programs that equip folks in rural and low-income communities with the tools they need to lead healthy lives.
Learn more: https://t.co/HP2ap3opD3

Yesterday, I heard from Cowlitz County emergency response and care leaders about how we can stop the spread of fentanyl and build a brighter future for those suffering from addiction.

We've got to make it easier to access treatment than to access these substances, which is why I'm fighting to secure our borders and cosponsored bipartisan bills which are now law to target fentanyl traffickers and fight smuggling at ports of entry.

Medicare Open Enrollment is open NOW through December 7.

You don’t need to re-enroll to keep your coverage, but you can take this time to explore other options.

Visit https://t.co/NsXS3EPpVQ, call 1-800-MEDICARE, or get free assistance online:
https://t.co/4UliN4YPpm

It'll support national health, local agriculture, and daycare access – at a time when family-based childcare providers are declining and we're importing 40% of our fresh fruits and vegetables. https://t.co/A31IRmxZ5i

To protect our freedoms and maintain a strong democracy, it’s critical we stay engaged and exercise our right to vote.

If you haven’t yet dropped off or mailed in your ballot, you don’t have to wait until Election Day!

It’s also not too late to register to vote. Just stop by your county elections office:
https://t.co/XSusjP2Wxk

Ensuring veterans can access high-quality healthcare to live healthy lives should be one of Congress’s highest priorities.

I’ve been working across the aisle to make it a reality for Southwest Washington veterans – because they put their lives on the line to protect freedom and democracy.

Where you choose to live shouldn’t impact the care you can access, so I introduced a bipartisan bill to expand transportation services for rural veterans to more easily get to their medical appointments – and I testified in support of it before the House Veterans Affairs Committee.

I also directly urged the VA Secretary to listen to the calls of Lewis County veterans to reopen a clinic – and I co-led the VET MEDS Act, which is now law to support veterans’ access to VA-certified specialists and examiners in rural and high-need communities.

Getting broadband lines in the ground isn't about having bandwidth to stream cat videos – it’s about accessing employment, healthcare, schoolwork, and resources to grow small businesses.

Expanding fiber in rural communities isn’t always commercially feasible, so these much-needed funds will jumpstart connection efforts in Lewis County.

Our rural and ag communities have been passed over for too long, so I’ll keep fighting for federal dollars to power investments like this one.

President Biden’s pardon of his son confirms a common belief I hear in Southwest Washington: that well-connected people are often gifted special treatment by a two-tier justice system.

The President made the wrong decision. No family should be above the law.

Great news – @ProbSolveCaucus endorsed our bipartisan GROWTH Act.

It will level the playing field for community colleges by opening up access to federal grants for nursing programs.

This is an important step forward toward addressing healthcare workforce shortages in rural communities and supporting folks pursuing nursing careers in their own communities, no matter where they attend school.

Learn more:
https://t.co/fsC8Uspi0e

PFAS chemicals harm our health, and our utilities work hard to dispose of these substances.

I intro'd a bipartisan bill to keep you and your water utility from bearing the cost of PFAS cleanup, & instead help ensure chemical producers are held to account.
https://t.co/oeJ9HKagWQ

When I spoke with local corrections officers, I heard how the fentanyl epidemic and lacking behavioral health resources make their jobs more difficult.

Their sacrifice often goes unrecognized, yet it's a vital public service, so I'm using tonight's Presidential address to honor their hard work.

Taking care of your health, newborn, or family when they’re most in need shouldn’t come at the cost of paying the bills.

Strong families mean strong communities and local economies.

With the paid family and medical leave tax credit due to expire, my bipartisan bill will make it permanent and expand access for WA-based businesses and newer employees, so more folks can benefit.

Learn more:
https://t.co/qSqyuvfdN5
